gen-gf-baloo-2-manrope: Manrope reads with a bright gap at every curve and one steady pen line, barely any step up to the capitals. Baloo 2 above it is the expressive one, bowls filling the line.
gen-gf-baloo-2-montserrat: Baloo 2 stands out for its open counters, which seem to breathe into the white space around them. Montserrat follows in a ruler-drawn, constant-width line that glides along like wire.
gen-gf-baloo-2-satoshi: Approachable from the first word, Satoshi hums softly across a paragraph with a soaring x-height. Baloo 2 is the distinctive voice above it, its bowls filling the line while the body stays out of the way.
gen-gf-baloo-2-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters with a tall waist line and a single flat weight in every glyph. And Baloo 2 does the opposite job, spending its open counters and full bowls on a display heading that gets noticed.
gen-gf-baloo-2-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and sets its mean line high, with spaghetti-like strokes of one width. Work Sans against Baloo 2's open, line-filling bowls gives a pair that is modern and distinctly expressive.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-archivo: Baloo Bhai 2 brings wide-mouthed lowercase rounds and letters that stretch high toward the top line. Archivo answers in a plain sans with outward-opening curves, so a roomy heading size lets that commanding x-height breathe.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-asap: Commanding is how Baloo Bhai 2 looks, with wide-mouthed rounds that stretch high toward the top line, and Asap sits below with a body height nearly matching its capitals. Shrink the heading and that weight fades.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase give Baloo Bhai 2 its swagger, stretching tall toward the top line above a body drawn in bent-steel strokes. The strongest quality here is the gap between brash display and wiry, unit-width Be Vietnam Pro.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-epilogue: Baloo Bhai 2 is loud, with rounded letters reaching high. Epilogue sits beside it on a wire-like monoline skeleton, curvy and loose with stubby ascender tips, and with none of a brush stroke's pressure swells.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-fs-fira-sans: Rounded lowercase letters reaching high with wide mouths are what mark Baloo Bhai 2 out. Fira Sans brings the strongest quality of the pair, a smooth drawn-wire line with big x-height and wide-open s curves.
